title: Miri Diagnostics Envelope
description: JSON envelope emitted by Miri compiler commands (check, build, run, test, explain) when --format json is specified. All diagnostic messages include a stable code for tooling integration.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Currently 1. A version gains optional fields and new `command` values as commands land, so a consumer must ignore members it does not recognise; the number changes only when an existing field changes shape or meaning.

ok.description: Whether the command did what was asked. Semantics are per-command; see the per-command table in agent-protocol.md.

command.description: The command that produced this envelope: 'check', 'build', 'run', 'test', 'explain', 'fix', 'determinism', 'view', 'patch', or 'skill'.

diagnostics.description: Array of diagnostic messages (errors, warnings, notes).

artifact.description: Path to the build artifact (for build/run commands only). Absent or null if no artifact was produced.

exitCode.description: Process exit code. Semantics vary by command: for run, this is the program's exit status; for other commands, 0 means ok, non-zero means failed. See the per-command table in agent-protocol.md.

stdoutTail.description: Last N bytes of the program's stdout (for run/test commands only). Absent or null if not captured.

stderrTail.description: Last N bytes of the program's stderr (for run/test commands only). Absent or null if not captured.

stdoutTruncated.description: True if stdoutTail was truncated; false if complete. Absent or null if stdout was not captured.

stderrTruncated.description: True if stderrTail was truncated; false if complete. Absent or null if stderr was not captured.

durationMs.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds for the command execution. Absent or null if not measured.

tests.description: Test summary (for test command only). Absent or null for other commands.

explanation.description: Documentation for one diagnostic code (for explain command only). Absent or null for other commands.

view.description: The canonical source a scoped read returned (view command only). Absent or null for other commands.

patch.description: Patch results: applied edits and revalidation count (patch command only). Absent or null for other commands.

skills.description: Skills from the embedded catalogue (skill command only). Absent or null for other commands.

JsonDiagnostic.description: A single diagnostic message (error, warning, or note).

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (e.g., 'MER_TYP_010') for documentation and tooling. Absent or null for some synthetic diagnostics.

path.description: Source file path where the issue occurred. Absent or null for diagnostics without a source location.

line.description: 1-indexed line number in source where the issue occurred. Absent or null if no source location.

column.description: 1-indexed column number in source where the issue occurred. Absent or null if no source location.

length.description: Length in bytes of the error span. Absent or null if no source location.

expected.description: Expected type/value for type mismatch errors. Only populated for explicitly-typed error variants (TypeMismatch, ArityMismatch, etc). Family-coded errors (those carrying a DiagnosticCode and message string) do not populate this field in schema version 1. See notes/PLAN.md for the follow-up to extract structured pairs from message text.

actual.description: Actual type/value for type mismatch errors. Only populated for explicitly-typed error variants (TypeMismatch, ArityMismatch, etc). Family-coded errors (those carrying a DiagnosticCode and message string) do not populate this field in schema version 1. See notes/PLAN.md for the follow-up to extract structured pairs from message text.

help.description: Actionable help text explaining how to resolve the issue. Absent or null if no help is available.

fixSafety.description: Fix-safety level of this diagnostic's repair, if the diagnostic carries a repair. One of: 'format-only', 'behavior-preserving', 'local-edit', 'api-changing', 'target-changing', or 'requires-human-review'. Absent or null if the diagnostic carries no repair.

repair.description: Always absent in schema version 1; reserved for the repair-plan surface in future versions.

related.description: Related diagnostics (notes, additional context). Empty if no related diagnostics.

preexisting.description: True if this diagnostic existed in the pre-edited version (patch command only). False if the edit introduced it. Absent or null for commands other than patch, for a patch command's own refusal notice (e.g., MER_BLD_011), or for a warning, which is never partitioned against the pre-edited version.

JsonRepair.description: A repair the compiler determined for this diagnostic, with the edits that carry it out.

id.description: Stable identifier for the repair shape: 'let-to-var', 'add-import', or 'drop-extra-arguments'.

edits.description: The edits that carry out this repair, in source order. Never empty: a repair exists only when the compiler determined the edit.

JsonEdit.description: A single edit to apply as part of a repair.

path.description: File path (absolute or relative) to edit.

replacement.description: Text replacing the range. Empty to delete the range; the range may be empty to insert.

JsonRelated.description: A related diagnostic (typically a note providing additional context).

severity.description: Severity level of the related diagnostic.

message.description: Human-readable message for the related diagnostic.

code.description: Diagnostic code if applicable. Absent or null if no code.

path.description: Source file path. Absent or null if no source location.

line.description: 1-indexed line number in source. Absent or null if no source location.

column.description: 1-indexed column number in source. Absent or null if no source location.

JsonTestSummary.description: Summary of test results (test command only).

total.description: Total number of tests run (including passed, failed, ignored, etc).

ignored.description: Number of tests that were ignored.

rejectedFiles.description: Files that were rejected from the test run (e.g., unparseable or declaring main).

detail.description: Additional detail about the test result (e.g., error message or timing). Absent or null if no detail.

code.description: Diagnostic code for assertion failures (e.g., "MER_RT_005"). Absent or null if no failure.

line.description: 1-indexed line number where the assertion failed. Absent or null if not applicable.

column.description: 1-indexed column number where the assertion failed. Absent or null if not applicable.

expected.description: For assert_eq, the expected value; for assert_panics, the expected message. Absent or null if not applicable.

actual.description: For assert_eq, the actual value; for assert_panics, the caught message. Absent or null if not applicable.

expression.description: The expression text for bare assert, or null/absent for other assertions.

message.description: Optional user-provided message for the assertion.

JsonRejectedFile.description: A file that was rejected from the test run.

JsonExplanation.description: A diagnostic code's documentation. Code, title, severity and reserved status come from the code registry; the remaining fields are parsed from the documentation file embedded for that code.

code.description: Wire string of the code being explained, e.g. 'MER_TYP_030'.

title.description: Short title of the code, from the registry.

reserved.description: True when the code is retired and no longer emitted by any check.

exampleBefore.description: Source showing the problem. Absent for a reserved code, which has no reproduction.

exampleAfter.description: The same source, repaired. Absent for a reserved code.

reference.description: Relative path to the reference page covering this area.

JsonView.description: Canonical source read back by the view command, with the position of each declaration inside it.

shape.description: Which shape was asked for: 'fn', 'outline', or 'around'.

text.description: The canonical source. Every span below indexes these bytes, not the bytes of the file on disk.

JsonViewSpan.description: One declaration's byte range within a view's text.

start.description: Byte offset where the declaration starts.

end.description: Byte offset one past the declaration's last byte.

kind.description: What kind of declaration this is, such as 'function' or 'class'.

name.description: The declared name, when the declaration has one.

JsonPatch.description: Results of a patch command: applied edits and metadata.

edits.description: Individual edits applied in the patch (each with raw byte range and replacement).

fileWritten.description: Whether the file was written to disk.

JsonPatchEdit.description: A single edit applied by the patch command.

start.description: Byte offset where the replacement starts in the raw source.

end.description: Byte offset one past the last replaced byte.

JsonSkill.description: A skill from the embedded catalogue.

compilerVersion.description: Compiler version stamped into the skill.

installedPath.description: Path where the skill was installed (install command only). Absent or null for list command.

unchanged.description: True when the target file already held exactly this text and was not rewritten (install command only). Absent or null for the list command.

body.description: The skill's markdown body, without its header (the skillsGet agent method only). Absent or null for the list and install commands.
